title: Great app but there’s this annoyance
body: I totally love this app. But I would love it more if you resolve this annoyance. In the task detail screen, the “Mark completed” button is at the bottom right, hidden behind the toast “Task completed | Undo” each time I mark a subtask done. Therefore, I cannot tap “Mark completed” button of the parent task until some seconds later when the toast auto disappears. Can you place it in a different position or at least reduce the toast width? Or maybe have an X button to allow me to get the toast away immediately
